context: Full pytest session (unit+integration) on one laptop; test trial profile warmup 1 s, 3 x 3 s paired windows at 40 req/s

before_amendment.method: median of per-window p95, candidate <= baseline * 1.10
before_amendment.identical_config_trials_4_vs_4: 6 of ~27 FAILED TRIAL-P95-REGRESSION (candidate p95 85.6-101.7 ms vs baseline 71-77 ms) in greenops_itest
before_amendment.effect: 3 integration tests failed: no approval-ready plan because the identical-config trial was rejected

after_amendment.method: pooled p95 over all latencies per side AND limit exceeded in a majority of paired windows; threshold unchanged (10%)
after_amendment.identical_config_trials_4_vs_4: 15 of 15 PASSED (idle machine, same test profile)

limit: Short windows on a shared laptop remain a noisy instrument; the production profile uses 10 s windows and the spec proposes 60 s.
